description: Read a file from the workspace on disk and return its text. Use it to check what a program or test file holds before editing it; to see what a running computer shows, use craftos_ui or craftos_read_terminal instead. Paths that leave the workspace are refused.

path.description: Workspace-relative path with forward slashes, e.g. "startup.lua" or "lib/ui.lua".

name: craftos_read_file
